History
The Catastrophe
＠緑'The Catastrophe'
＠緑▽June 6, 1991: A massive explosion of unknown cause at the Chernoton Research Institute in Moscow.
＠緑The germ weapon 'Lucifer-α', then under development by the old Soviet military, leaked into the air, causing the largest bio-hazard (biological leak) in history.
＠緑Within a week it wiped out nearly 80% of Eastern Europe and the Eurasian continent.
＠緑▽Six months later, 'Lucifer-α', closing in on Asia, mutated and turned harmless.
＠緑▽Since then, the depopulated northern Eurasian region has remained, under the world's watchful eye, a UN neutral territory to this day.
＠緑The above events are known as 'The Catastrophe'.
＠緑▽After the incident, countless reports were filed, yet the truth of it has never been revealed.
World War III

＠緑'World War III'
　(2005-2006)
＠緑▽August 24, 2005: World War III breaks out over the 'UN Neutral Territory', which for 14 years since 'The Catastrophe' had been the largest buffer zone.
＠緑▽China gave military backing to right-wing remnants of the old Soviet army who had survived the Catastrophe, and moved to invade the neutral zone.
＠緑▽But the West's economic blockade forced China to withdraw with little resistance, and the UN forces claimed victory.
＠緑This war, over in a mere six months, is called the 'Half-Year War'.
Siberian Neutral Territory
＠緑'Siberian Neutral Territory'
＠緑▽Left uninhabited by the Catastrophe, the Siberian region is administered by the UN and has been abandoned as a non-intervention zone for 50 years.
＠緑This is because, due to the after-effects of 'Lucifer-α', no plant or animal life can grow there for the next half-century.
＠緑▽Fearing a resurgence of 'World War III', the UN dispatches a 'Siberian Search Team' each year to keep watch over the neutral zone.
Abolition of Nukes
＠緑'Eradication of Nuclear Weapons'
＠緑▽The 1987 INF Treaty (Intermediate-Range Nuclear Forces) set things in motion, and strategic nuclear arms have been cut back ever since.
＠緑▽In 2007, with the IAEA (International Atomic Energy Agency) enforcing the 'Agreement to Halt Production of Weapons-Grade Fissile Material'...
＠緑the military nukes of UN member states were eradicated. Some non-member states, however, are said to still produce and hold nuclear weapons.
＠緑Today only the so-called 'nuclear deterrent', kept under UN control for peacekeeping, remains.
Witch Hunt

　(Bioroid Hunt)

＠緑▽This 'Witch Hunt' died down once it was learned that snatching targeted only important figures, but...

＠緑As a result, though illegal, 'black-market taxis' operate openly and are even organized.
＠緑Given all this, the government can no longer ignore them, and from next April a new law will take effect that, for these illegal operators,...
＠緑moves toward legalization by granting operating licenses after screening.
Culture & Science
Science
Space Development
＠緑　　　　'Space Development'
＠緑In the late 20th century, plans were laid to send humanity into space, but the decline of Earth's environment—through accelerating global warming, bio-hazards, and the like—
＠緑only spurred this trend on.
＠緑With the U.S. building the space station 'Freedom' and developing fusion rockets, humanity's push into space advanced by leaps and bounds.
＠緑In 2010, humanity's first space colony, 'Beyond Coast', was completed, making migration to space a reality.
＠緑Today a lunar base mines helium-3 for fusion, and the push toward Mars is under way as well.
Martian Chronicles
＠緑'Planetary Exploration Data on Mars'
＠緑▽August 1988: The Phobos Program surveys Mars and its moons Phobos and Deimos with Phobos 1 and 2. (USSR)
＠緑▽October 1989: The Mars Observer probe explores Mars, surveying its weather and geology. (USA)
＠緑▽1992: The Vesta Program. Exploration of Mars, asteroids, and comets.
＠緑Initially led by the Eastern European nations, it was taken over with U.S. aid after the chaos of the Catastrophe.

＠緑▽2005
Work begins on the unmanned Martian robot factory 'Wells'.

＠緑▽2012
First manned flight to Mars.

＠緑▽2015
Work begins on the manned experimental base 'Le Guin'.

＠緑▽2022
Work begins on the Martian spaceport 'McCaffrey'.

＠緑▽2025
The early Martian base 'Dick' is completed.

＠緑▽2030
The full-scale Martian base 'Burroughs' goes online.

＠緑▽2035
Mars Mine No. 1, 'Asimov', begins operation.
Mars Greening Plan
＠緑　　　'Mars Greening Plan'
＠緑A plan to turn the uninhabited planet Mars into a green, living land like Earth.
＠緑First, mirrors placed in Mars orbit increase the sunlight reaching the surface, while greenhouse gases are released on the ground...
＠緑to warm Mars until yeasts and bacteria can live there.
＠緑Then, using the oxygen those yeasts and microbes produce, it is made habitable for more advanced life.
＠緑The vast underground reserves of frozen water revealed by Martian base surveys have suddenly given this plan real credibility.
＠緑The plan now moves forward under the slogans 'From Red Planet to Green Land' and 'New Martian Colony', and as its first stage...
＠緑the solar mirrors are scheduled to be installed in 2045.
＠緑Recently, the 'Beagle Jerusalem', carrying the first Mars survey migrant group, was launched.
Bio-Comm
＠緑'Bio-Communication'
＠緑Communication without language, achieved by mechanically detecting a living being's biological responses—such as the chemicals it emits—and turning them into signals.
＠緑Communication between humans and other creatures is hoped for in the future, but for ethical reasons, for now humans only...

＠緑observe and study other creatures—it stays one-way.
The workings of vertebrate consciousness, meanwhile,...
＠緑together with PET (positron emission tomography) studies of brain activity, are becoming almost fully understood.
Dream Coder
＠緑　'Dream Coder'

＠緑A device that records a person's dreams.
Working mainly from brainwave signals, it renders and records sight, sound, taste, and touch.
＠緑However, only a qualified psychoanalyst or counselor may play them back.
＠緑Moreover, they are not currently admissible as legal evidence.
Culture & Sports
Bio-Zoo
＠緑　　　'Bio-Zoo'
＠緑A living genetic museum housing protected animals—genetically engineered rarities and extinct species.
＠緑It was created by the International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN) to protect, restore, and breed endangered mammals, birds, and the like.
＠緑Beyond keeping live animals, it also cryogenically preserves the genes of every species.
＠緑In '42, the birth of a baby unicorn (a successful natural birth) made headlines.
＠緑This baby unicorn has even been made a mascot of Neo Kobe.
Robo-Musical
＠緑'Robo-Musical'
＠緑A musical performed by humanoid robots.
＠緑Each robot's expressions and movements are sampled from real actors, so the performance is indistinguishable from the real thing.
＠緑The appeal of the robot musical lies in reproducing various actors' performances flawlessly, any number of times.
＠緑Simply changing the software allows different productions, and lately software for traditional arts like kabuki and noh has grown popular too.
＠緑And because it can recreate the performances and dances of legendary actors of old, it enjoys support among elderly theater fans as well.
＠緑As of '42, the long-running hit still going strong is... 'The Phantom of the Opera'.
Pochette Pet
＠緑'Pochette Pet'
＠緑A pet bred from marsupials that doubles as a pouch bag.
＠緑By adding the extra value of doubling as a bag, it became a huge hit in the '40s.
＠緑It first appeared in commercials for a different purpose, but after some media picked it up, it built a huge craze as the Pochette Pet.
＠緑At the time, disputes broke out among several companies over the rights to the Pochette Pet.
＠緑In '41, complaints from the animal welfare society caused it to cool off for a while.
Kobe-yaki
＠緑　　　'Kobe-yaki'
＠緑A dish born when a student dropped okonomiyaki ingredients into a pot of dashi broth.
＠緑The name plays on the way the ingredients float up in the broth, combined with Neo Kobe.
＠緑Depending on the ingredients inside, all sorts of Kobe-yaki now abound.
＠緑Today Kobe-yaki has caught on nationwide as a new Kansai food culture.
Retina Reading
＠緑'Retina Reading'
＠緑A new kind of high-tech fortune-telling that reads a person's fate from their retinal pattern.
＠緑It stems from the fact that retinal patterns, like fingerprints and voiceprints, differ from person to person.
Aero-Surfing
＠緑'Aero-Surfing'
＠緑A sport enjoying explosive popularity among the young.
＠緑In a city whose seas have been polluted, a new form of surfing based on aerodynamics has captured today's surfers.
＠緑Aero-surfing needs only protective gear, an air surfboard, and a simple air-wave generator (Air Wave System)
＠緑to enjoy casually, so it caught on especially among the young people of the slums.
＠緑Wave height can be freely controlled and it can be done year-round, so tournaments are held everywhere.
Dragon Force
＠緑'Dragon Force'
＠緑A sport ridden on genetically engineered winged horses (Dragon Horses).
＠緑A high-society sport imported from England, contested on gliding distance and gliding time.
＠緑The winged Dragon Horse is about the size of a small pony, with a flight range of roughly 40 to 70 meters.
＠緑In Neo Kobe, the first official tournament was held on an offshore platform in '40.
＠緑The winning record of the first tournament was 82 meters over 30 seconds of flight, set by an invited foreign horse of the Oración Highlander breed.
Politics
City Quarantine Policy
＠緑'City Quarantine Policy'
＠緑Taking the 'SNATCHER contamination' in Neo Kobe City gravely, the government declared the city a contaminated zone,
＠緑and the cabinet resolved to forcibly seal off every land and sea route except the Neo Kobe Bridge.
＠緑It was put into effect on December 1, 2042.
＠緑This halted contamination of other regions, but deepened the city's isolation.
＠緑Yet the SNATCHER problem has reached the present day with no fundamental solution in sight.
North-South Divide
＠緑'The North-South Divide'
＠緑Since the 2020 'Multiethnic City Declaration', many peoples and races have migrated to Neo Kobe City, but this inevitably...
＠緑came to split society and open a divide between rich and poor.
＠緑The wealthy long-time residents settled mainly around the government district in the city's north, while the poor newcomers took root in the developing areas of the south.
＠緑What spurred this trend was the flood of immigrants who poured in after 'The Catastrophe'.
＠緑As they built up the so-called 'underworld', the city came to hold two societies—the 'North' and the 'South'.
Freemen
＠緑'The Freemen'
＠緑The homeless (Freemen) who live having erased their personal data from the databanks of the state and community.
＠緑In today's highly information-driven age, erasing one's registered data is to deny one's social existence, and the rise of 'Freemen'...
＠緑is having a serious impact in places, as a matter of public order and labor.
＠緑Those who become 'Freemen' are often people in computer-network professions, making it a new problem of the information age.
＠緑The Freemen mostly settle in areas outside information control and underground in the ruins of the Tube Liner.
Immigration Problem
＠緑'The Immigration Problem'
＠緑Having lost their homeland to 'The Catastrophe', the Eurasian population fled outward, giving rise to the problem of mass immigration.
＠緑Chinese immigrants were especially numerous; some 100,000 poured into Japan over a total of five waves.
＠緑The Japanese government concentrated most of the immigrants it took in within Neo Kobe City, which then billed itself a 'multiethnic city'.
＠緑As a result, the Chinese became the city's second-largest population after the Japanese, but their standard of living was low, and most of them...
＠緑are forced to live in the slums of the 'South'.
＠緑Many Chinese immigrants resent this, and most of them have become an underground force, forming an underworld beyond the reach of the authorities.
Kyoto Summit
＠緑　　'Kyoto Summit'
＠緑A summit (of the leading industrial nations) scheduled to be held in Kyoto in December 2042.
＠緑Its main theme is the question of resource ownership in the Siberian neutral zone, but with the SNATCHER problem also on the agenda, it has the media abuzz.
＠緑SNATCHER contamination has the whole world's attention, yet there have been no SNATCHER sightings in any city outside Neo Kobe...
＠緑so ways to keep SNATCHERs from escaping the city are expected to be discussed.
＠緑Attention on the summit surged when the French premier stated the city should be wiped out with a nuclear strike.
Info-Control-Free Zone
＠緑'The Info-Control-Free Zone'
＠緑Neo Kobe is split between the centralized information-managed zone, run by fiber optics and satellites, and the slum areas that slipped through that control.
＠緑Those who cannot obtain identity verification or an ID inevitably gather outside this information-managed zone.
＠緑Here no card of any kind works, and cash alone is accepted as currency.
＠緑The city has submitted bills to clear out this area for several years, but for various reasons none has yet passed.
＠緑In fact, nearly 30% of the city is designated as this information-control-free zone.
＠緑Counting candidate areas not yet designated, it reaches as much as 40%.
